-- class: contract
-- name: view

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-role
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create role "mig" with nosuperuser nocreatedb nocreaterole inherit nologin;

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig" in schema "public" revoke execute on functions from public;

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig" in schema "public" grant execute on functions to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig" in schema "public" grant select on sequences to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig" in schema "public" grant usage on sequences to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig" in schema "public" grant delete on tables to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig" in schema "public" grant insert on tables to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig" in schema "public" grant select on tables to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig" in schema "public" grant update on tables to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig" in schema "public" grant select on tables to "report";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."people" (
  "id" text not null,
  "secret" text not null,
  constraint "people_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-view
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create view "public"."notes" as select id, secret from people;

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant usage on schema "public" to "report";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant delete on table "public"."people" to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant insert on table "public"."people" to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on table "public"."people" to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on table "public"."people" to "report";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant update on table "public"."people" to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant delete on table "public"."notes" to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant insert on table "public"."notes" to "app";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on table "public"."notes" to "app";

-- class: contract
-- kind: revoke
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
revoke select on table "public"."notes" from "report";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select ("id") on table "public"."notes" to "report";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant update on table "public"."notes" to "app";
